newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIA V CYPRUS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIA V CYPRUS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's World Cup European group five qualifier between Bulgaria and Cyprus:

Bulgaria - 1-Zdravko Zdravkov; 2-Radostin Kishishev, 3-Trifon Ivanov, 4-Gosho Ginchev, 5-Ivailo Yordanov, 6-Zlatko Yankov, 7-Emil Kostadinov, 8-Daniel Borimirov, 9-Georgi Donkov, 10-Krasimir Balakov, 11-Ilian Iliev

Cyprus - 1-Andreas Petrides; 2-Georgios Theodotou, 3- Charalambos Pittas, 4-Sozos Yiannaki, 5-Angelos Misos, 6- Neophytos Larcou, 7-Nicodemos Papavassiliou, 8-Panayiotis Engomitis, 9-Klimis Alexandrou, 10-Marios Charalambous, 11-Nikolaos Timotheou
